meta_title: Tree Solutions Leeds | Arborist & Tree Surgery
meta_description: Tree Solutions Leeds provides professional tree surgery, pruning, and removal across Leeds. Expert arborists, competitive rates, free quotes. Call today.
hero_subhead: Dangerous branches threatening your garden? We handle tree surgery, felling, and stump removal across Leeds—safely and professionally.
services_heading: Tree Surgery & Removal Services Across Leeds
services_subhead: From routine pruning to emergency storm damage, we deliver the full range of arboricultural work for homeowners and businesses.

services.title: Tree Felling
services.desc: Safe, controlled removal of hazardous or unwanted trees. We manage the entire process—from permits through to stump grinding and site clearance.

services.title: Crown Reduction & Pruning
services.desc: Thin out overgrown canopies to restore light and air to your garden. Improves tree health and prevents branches damaging your property or neighbours' fences.

services.title: Stump Grinding
services.desc: Remove tree stumps completely below ground level. Prevents regrowth and restores your garden for replanting or landscaping.

services.title: Emergency Storm Damage
services.desc: Broken branches, fallen trees, or storm-damaged limbs? We respond quickly to make your property safe and clear debris.

services.title: Tree Surveys & Reports
services.desc: Professional assessment for subsidence risk, insurance claims, or planning disputes. Detailed reports for your insurer or solicitor.

services.title: Hedge Cutting & Maintenance
services.desc: Tidy overgrown hedges and maintain seasonal growth. We work to your preferred height and shape, leaving clean, healthy plants.

about_pullquote: We treat every garden like it's our own—safe, tidy, and done right.
about_para_1: Tree Solutions Leeds was founded by qualified arborists frustrated with cowboys charging inflated prices for poor work. Over 18 years, we've built a reputation for honest pricing, skilled workmanship, and genuine care for your trees. We're based in Moortown and have managed over 2,000 trees across Leeds and beyond.
about_para_2: Our team holds professional qualifications in arboriculture and stays current with industry standards. Customers return because we listen, we're transparent about what's needed (and what isn't), and we clean up properly. We're not the flashiest operation—we're the one your neighbours trust.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Tree Solutions

reviews.text: Had a massive oak that was leaning toward the house. Got quotes from three other firms—all were trying to charge a fortune. Tree Solutions came out, explained what was really needed, and did the job for less than half the price. Work was spotless. Really pleased.
reviews.author: Michael P.

reviews.text: Storm blew down two trees in our back garden. Called them on Sunday afternoon, they came out Monday morning, removed everything, stumps ground, site swept clean. No fuss, fair price, professional throughout. Couldn't have asked for better.
reviews.author: Judith H.

reviews.text: Been using them for hedge trimming and tree work for four years now. They're reliable, tidy, and honest about what needs doing. No high-pressure upsell tactics. Definitely recommend to anyone in Leeds.
reviews.author: David T.
